title: Form MGT-7
question: What is Form MGT-7, and what if it is missed?

body.normal: Form MGT-7 is the company's annual return. It gives the Registrar a yearly snapshot of the company: its shareholders, directors, share capital and meetings held.
body.simple: MGT-7 is the yearly update telling the Registrar who owns and runs the company.
body.detail: The annual return is filed after the annual general meeting. It records the shareholding at year end, changes in directors, and the board and shareholder meetings held during the year.
body.why: Together with AOC-4 it keeps the company in good standing on the public record.

facts.v: Yearly return of shareholders, directors and capital
Your firm prepares and files it; you approve the figures
An additional fee for each day of delay, and penalties on the company and its officers if it stays unfiled.
